_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 43: Conformity Assessment
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity. A harmonised standard or European standardisation deliverable on conformity assessment for AI systems is being developed under Commission Implementing Decision C(2025) 3871, Annex I, point 10. No official date for publication of a harmonised-standard reference, if applicable, has been announced.
basis: EU AI Act Annexes VI and VII
_metadata.awaiting_standard: A harmonised standard or European standardisation deliverable on conformity assessment for AI systems is being developed under Commission Implementing Decision C(2025) 3871, Annex I, point 10. No official date for publication of a harmonised-standard reference, if applicable, has been announced.

requirements.title: Conformity Assessment Completion
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST complete the applicable conformity assessment procedure (Annex VI, Annex VII, or the procedure required by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I) before the high-risk AI system is placed on the market or put into service.
requirements.rationale: Art. 16(f), together with Art. 43(1)-(3), requires the relevant conformity assessment before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service.
acceptable_implementations: Annex VI internal control for Annex III points 2-8 systems that are not also covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, and for Annex III point 1 systems not so covered only where Art. 43(1) permits that option

Annex VII assessment with notified-body involvement for Annex III point 1 systems not also covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I where chosen or required under Art. 43(1)

Conformity assessment under the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, including the Section 2 requirements, assessment of the Art. 17 quality management system and the Annex VII provisions listed in Art. 43(3)

requirements.title: Substantial Modification Tracking
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST have a process to identify substantial modifications and trigger re-assessment.
requirements.rationale: Art. 43(4) requires new assessment on substantial modification.
acceptable_implementations: Change management process with classification criteria
Version control with modification impact assessment
Change review board for AI system modifications
